project.title: Vampire: The Masquerade Character Creator
project.summary: A browser-based Vampire: The Masquerade V5 creator with Core and optional Player’s Guide choices, XP advancement, chronicle presets, a searchable rules reference, and local character and coterie planning tools.

items.title: Point players to the matching JSON restore control
items.notes: When a valid character backup is selected in the coterie planner, point to Browser drafts. When a valid coterie handoff is selected in Browser drafts, point to Coterie & Domain. Verify both directions with the documented sample files. Wrong-format and malformed files must leave the current draft, step, coterie plan, and saved libraries intact.

items.title: Review sample handoffs with a player and a Storyteller
items.notes: Deferred at the maintainer’s request. The sample brief, coterie plan, and starting draft are ready. Internal Chromium walkthrough verified download, restore, reload, and preservation of the open draft. Resume the player and Storyteller walkthroughs in the release verification record and use their feedback to rank follow-ups. The hosted pilot remains deferred pending this feedback and a separate decision.

items.title: Verify Foundry V5 actor import compatibility
items.notes: Deferred until a disposable Foundry V5 test world or paired vampire actor exports are available. Start with the World of Darkness 5e system (wod5e). Record the exact versions and compare a sample vampire actor export with its re-export after import. Document fields and embedded items that survive, mapping gaps, and the scope of a first exporter.
